data: China's GNSS — global ops since 2020; unique MEO + IGSO + GEO hybrid
CNSA + China Satellite Navigation Office BeiDou-3 system. Spans MEO (24 sats) + IGSO (3 sats) + GEO (3 sats), unique hybrid architecture.

China's GNSS, formally BeiDou-3 in current form. Unique hybrid architecture mixing MEO (24 satellites at 21,500 km, 55°), inclined geosynchronous (IGSO, 3 satellites), and GEO (3 satellites). Full global coverage declared July 2020. The only GNSS with short-message satellite communication capability built into the signal — users can send short text messages directly through the constellation, useful in remote-area emergency comms.

GEO mobile comms — maritime, aviation, GMDSS backbone

Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
China's global navigation satellite system. 46+ satellites across MEO, GEO, and IGSO orbits. Provides global coverage since 2020. Also functions as a messaging service — satellites relay short texts.
